mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay_message_outbox(event_no,event_type,business_key,aggregate_no,schema_version,payload,payload_hash) VALUES(#{eventNo},#{eventType},#{businessKey},#{aggregateNo},#{schemaVersion},#{payload},#{payloadHash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_no=event_no
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pay_message_outbox WHERE event_type=#{type} AND business_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM pay_message_outbox WHERE next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (status='PENDING' OR (status='SENDING' AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pay_message_outbox SET status='SENDING', attempts=attempts+1, execute_version=execute_version+1,lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,120,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND execute_version=#{version} AND (status='PENDING' OR (status='SENDING' AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))

UPDATE pay_message_outbox SET status='SENT',lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND execute_version=#{version} AND status='SENDING' AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE pay_message_outbox SET status=#{status},last_error=#{error},lease_until=NULL, next_retry_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{delay},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND execute_version=#{version} AND status='SENDING' AND lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE pay_message_outbox SET status='PENDING',attempts=0,execute_version=execute_version+1, next_retry_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_no=#{eventNo} AND status='FAILED'
